question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
The practice covers the entire range of existence.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality which pervades all levels from Śiva to Avīci.
